purpose: Teach: 目録/一挙/チェンジ/扶養/誘致/下部/所在地/本編

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室の蔵書目録を整理しろ
lines.en: Ren — organize the lab's book catalogue.
lines.style: Clear, measured directive. Slight pause before the task name. Composed authority without harshness. The tone of someone who knows Ren can handle it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会発表で成果を一挙に公開します
lines.en: Yes. I'll present all the findings at the conference.
lines.style: Formal, respectful. Slight eagerness underneath the politeness. Steady eye contact. Speaking clearly to show he understands the responsibility.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究テーマを思い切ってチェンジしろ
lines.en: Ren — I want you to make a bold shift in your research theme.
lines.style: Direct, almost gentle. Slight weight on the word 'bold.' Not a suggestion — a conviction. The pause before the task carries genuine concern for his development.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。扶養家族のいる先輩を尊敬しております
lines.en: Yes. I respect the senior researchers who have dependents to support.
lines.style: Quiet, almost vulnerable. Slightly off-topic — he's thinking out loud, touching on something that matters to him. Hesitant delivery, like he's admitting something.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外研究者の誘致活動にも参加しろ
lines.en: Ren — I also want you involved in recruiting overseas researchers.
lines.style: Steady, confident instruction. Light emphasis on 'also' to show this adds to rather than replaces. Delegating because he trusts Ren's potential.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。組織下部の若手研究者の意見も聞きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure to listen to the younger researchers down the line too.
lines.style: Polite, careful phrasing. Shows he's thinking about hierarchy and inclusion. Slightly formal register. A small nod in his voice to show he takes this seriously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の所在地、つまり投稿先を慎重に選べ
lines.en: Ren — choose your journal submission carefully. Where your paper lands matters.
lines.style: Deliberate, almost pausing on the word 'carefully.' This is wisdom being passed down. Warm but serious. The tone of someone who's seen papers flounder in the wrong venue.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の本編を仕上げます
lines.en: Yes. I'll have the main manuscript ready to submit.
lines.style: Affirmation with finality. Crisp, resolved tone. A small lift at the end — not quite relief, but the steadiness of someone closing out a chapter and moving to the next.
